name: 13077 · Homer, NY
findings: ZIP 13077 (Homer) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13077 (Homer) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13077 (Homer) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
